meta.name: pdf-text-replace
meta.description: Replace text in fillable PDF forms by updating form field values. This skill should be used when users need to update names, addresses, dates, or other text in PDF form fields.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 更新可填写PDF表单中的文本字段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量或自动更新PDF表单中的姓名、地址等字段
copy.tagline_en: Update text fields in fillable PDF forms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch or automatically update names, addresses, etc. in PDF forms

howto.what: 这个技能能扫描PDF里可填写的表单元件，把指定文字替换成新文字，并生成一份新PDF，同时保留原有表单结构。它只改动表单字段，不碰普通文本或扫描件。
howto.when: 当用户需要更新PDF表单中的姓名、地址、日期等文字时触发。前提是PDF带可填写字段（未扁平化）。

say.text: 把这个PDF表单里的“张三”改成“李四”
say.note: 技能会扫描所有表单字段并替换匹配项。

say.text: 把这份税表里的地址换成“北京路1号”
say.note: 生成新PDF并保留原表单结构。

say.text: 将PDF里的日期字段更新为2025年6月1日
say.note: 修改后报告被改动字段的数量。

howto.what_en: This skill scans fillable form fields in a PDF, replaces specified text with new text, and produces a new PDF while preserving the form structure. It only edits form field values, not static text or scanned images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to update names, addresses, dates, or other text in PDF form fields. Requires a fillable PDF (not flattened).

say_en.text: Change "John Smith" to "Jon Smith" in this PDF form.
say_en.note: Scans all fields and replaces matches.

say_en.text: Update the address to "1 Beijing Road" in this tax form.
say_en.note: Creates a new PDF with original structure.

say_en.text: Set the date field to June 1, 2025 in this PDF.
say_en.note: Reports how many fields were modified.
